description: This file defines the WindowSpec class used for specifying window functions in Spark SQL, including partitioning, ordering, and frame boundaries.

classes.name: WindowSpec
classes.description: A class representing window specifications for partitioning, ordering, and frame boundaries in Spark SQL.

methods.name: partitionBy
methods.description: Defines the partitioning columns for the window specification.

methods.name: orderBy
methods.description: Defines the ordering columns for the window specification.

methods.name: rowsBetween
methods.description: Sets the frame boundaries based on row offsets.

methods.name: rangeBetween
methods.description: Sets the frame boundaries based on value ranges.

methods.name: withFrame
methods.description: Creates a new WindowSpec with specified frame boundaries.

methods.name: withAggregate
methods.description: Converts the WindowSpec into a Column with an aggregate expression.
